summary.text: Michael Rulli is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Ohio's 6th District, first elected in a June 2024 special election. Before Congress he worked in his family's Rulli Bros. Markets business, served on the Leetonia school board, and served in the Ohio State Senate from 2019 to 2024. He is seeking re-election in 2026.

paragraphs.text: Rulli was born in Mahoning County, Ohio, on March 11, 1969, and graduated from Poland Seminary High School.
He earned bachelor's degrees in communications and speech from Emerson College in 1991, then joined the family business, Rulli Bros. Markets, where he served as director of operations.
His House website describes him as a lifelong Mahoning Valley resident who lives in Salem, Ohio.
Rulli served on the school board of the Leetonia Exempted Village School District in Columbiana County for eight years, his only elected office before the state Senate.

He was elected to the Ohio State Senate (District 33) in 2018, defeating John Boccieri, and re-elected in 2022. He served from 2019 until resigning in June 2024 to join Congress, representing Mahoning, Columbiana and Carroll counties.

Rulli won the Republican nomination on March 19, 2024, and the June 11, 2024 special general election over Democrat Michael Kripchak for the seat vacated by Bill Johnson. He was sworn in on June 25, 2024, and won a full term in November 2024 with about 66% of the vote.
In the 119th Congress (2025-2026) he serves on the Committee on Energy and Commerce (Health; Oversight and Investigations; Energy subcommittees) and the Committee on Education and Workforce.
He also co-chairs the bicameral, bipartisan Italian American Congressional Delegation.
